meta.name: Invoice Template Customizer — design tokens
meta.structure: 3-tier — primitive (raw scale) → semantic (role aliases, derived) → component (named intent)
meta.usage: Values are copy-exact from the shipped HTML prototype's :root. Colour primitives use oklch(); semantic colours are CSS color-mix() expressions that reference the primitives by CSS custom property — paste `css` verbatim into a :root or a Tailwind v4 `@theme` block to get working derived colours. Component tokens that are pure numeric aliases (e.g. control-sm → space-9) are pre-resolved to their pixel value for direct use in JS/RN, with the alias noted for traceability.

spacing.description: 4px grid, 2px half-steps below 20px. Key = CSS var suffix (space-{key}).

md.value: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--fg) 6%, transparent), 0 12px 32px -12px color-mix(in oklch, var(--fg) 12%, transparent)

semantic.description: Derived from primitives via CSS color-mix()/var() — resolve correctly only when the primitive tier is present in the same cascade. Values below are copy-exact CSS expressions, not pre-computed colours.

mutedText.description: ≥4.5:1 contrast on --bg — the only variant of --muted approved for small text

body.description: Running UI text — also the <body> base size

component.description: Named intent for one-off layout constants — not part of the generic scale, kept as their own tokens so the number reads as a decision, not a magic value.

md.description: Text inputs, primary buttons, colour swatches

paneCustomizeWidth.description: Fixed width of the left editor pane at ≥1024px

paperMaxWidth.description: Max width of the invoice document card on desktop

paperWidthUnitless.description: Read by JS for the compact fit-to-width scale calc — deliberately unitless

stickyFooterClearance.description: Compact layout: bottom padding that clears the fixed Cancel/Save bar
